name: What Comes Around...
summary: Guard Berton in Lakeshire is pressing for Targorr the Dread's execution. The Blackrock orc remains in Stormwind Stockade despite his sentence, while political delays keep justice out of reach.

sections.title: A Butcher Held in Limbo
sections.body: Targorr the Dread earned his name in the Redridge Mountains, where he served as supreme executioner under General Gath'Ilzogg, chieftain of the Blackrock orcs at Stonewatch Keep. Even among the invaders, his cruelty was notorious. He oversaw the torture and execution of many Redridge defenders. After his capture, Stormwind sent him to its high-security prison, the Stormwind Stockade, and condemned him to die for his crimes against the realm.

sections.title: Corruption in High Places
sections.body: An unnamed nobleman in Stormwind's House of Nobles intervened, and Targorr's execution stopped despite his sentence. Guard Berton, stationed in vulnerable Lakeshire, suspects foul play or bribery meant to free the brute. He recruits trusted adventurers to enter the riot-torn prison and carry out the order without bureaucratic interference.

faq.answer: Targorr the Dread is a Blackrock orc who served as supreme executioner under General Gath'Ilzogg in Redridge. He tortured captured human soldiers before his capture and imprisonment in the Stormwind Stockade.

faq.q: Why hasn't Stormwind executed Targorr yet?
faq.answer: A nobleman in Stormwind delayed Targorr's execution despite his sentence. Guard Berton suspects corruption or foul play meant to spare or exploit the orc warlord.

faq.q: Who gives the quest What Comes Around...?
faq.answer: Guard Berton gives it. He is stationed in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains, where he guards the town against Blackrock orc incursions.

faq.q: Where can Targorr the Dread be found?
faq.answer: Targorr is held in the Stormwind Stockade, in Stormwind City's canal district. He is usually found in a cell in the prison's central cell block.
General Gath'Ilzogg commands the Blackrock orcs occupying Stonewatch Keep in eastern Redridge. Targorr served under him as executioner.

faq.q: Why does Guard Berton take matters into his own hands?
faq.answer: Berton saw Redridge soldiers suffer and die under Targorr's blades. Disgusted that Stormwind politicians are treating a ruthless murderer as a political pawn, he bypasses official channels to secure justice.

angles.text: For the Alliance, this reveals the divide between frontier garrisons like Lakeshire and the self-serving politics of Stormwind's noble courts.
As a human of the kingdom, you can settle personal debts for the atrocities Targorr committed against Redridge town guards and militia during the Blackrock invasion.
As a paladin, you face the conflict between written law and moral justice when you bypass a corrupt legal delay to punish an unrepentant torturer.
